t: You're looking at St Nicholas Greek Orthodox Cathedral, an Eastern Orthodox cathedral in London. It takes its name from Saint Nicholas, a fourth-century bishop of Greek descent from Patara in Anatolia. He's the patron saint of sailors, merchants, children, students and many others, and is known as Nicholas the Wonderworker because of the miracles attributed to him. His habit of secret gift-giving is what gave rise to the folklore of Santa Claus.
